decision: Use a test-only spawned qrexec child entrypoint to terminate at before-mutation, after-durable-mutation-before-journal-commit, and after-journal-commit-before-stdout boundaries while leaving the production service entrypoint free of fault switches.

correctness.reason: Adapter-level injected exceptions prove state-machine behavior but do not prove process-per-call qrexec durability across actual process death. The spawned harness exercises filesystem locks, MissionQueueStore, DurableRequestJournal, adapter reconciliation, and response emission boundaries together.
required_results: before mutation: no journal entry and no mission mutation; retry executes once
after claim mutation: one durable claim, pending journal, retry returns attested indeterminate, no second claim
after journal commit before stdout: committed response is replayed without a second mutation
after complete mutation: retry reconciles read-only from the exact durable terminal postcondition

robustness_security.winner: test-only crash child, no production fault environment variable
robustness_security.reason: A production crash switch would create an avoidable denial-of-service/control surface. The test-only child injects process exit by wrapping the already injectable handler boundary and never changes the production service configuration contract.

latency_resources_regression.winner: short-lived Node child processes only in QA
latency_resources_regression.reason: The harness adds zero production qrexec round trips, no daemon, no database, no additional fsync in production, and no persistent process state. Runtime cost exists only in tests.
rejected: production fault switch: unnecessary runtime/security surface
daemonized crash simulator: extra lifecycle, RAM, IPC, and regression risk
adapter-only exceptions: lower fidelity for process-death semantics

failures_lessons: A thrown exception inside the adapter is not equivalent evidence to OS process death at the qrexec service boundary.
Crash points must distinguish mutation durability from journal durability and response delivery; otherwise exactly-once claims become ambiguous.

Complete can be reconciled only because the durable postcondition proves the same mission, worker, fencing token, and result; claim/heartbeat/fail remain indeterminate after unknown post-mutation death.
Fault injection belongs in test-only entrypoints rather than production configuration.
safety: Synthetic defensive transport qualification only. No real financial transactions, payment data, fraud workflows, or weakened security controls.
